description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the WorkShiftEmployeeAPI, focusing on testing its API endpoints such as 'getAll', and verifying that other methods like 'create' and 'delete' throw not implemented exceptions. It utilizes test data providers, mocks services, and inherits from an endpoint integration test base class, indicating its role in API-level testing within the OrangeHRM project.
